about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Lamb Shoulder with Garlic, Rosemary and Chickpeas
recipes.summary: Lamb shoulder cooked until it falls apart over garlic, rosemary and chickpeas, with flatbread to serve.
steps: Rub the lamb with the oil, rosemary and salt and sit it on the onion, garlic and chickpeas in the slow cooker.
Pour over the lemon and stock and cook on low for 8 hours until the lamb shreds with a fork.
Shred, toss in the juices and serve with the flatbread.
notes: Contains gluten.
Food safety: cook lamb until tender and at least 75°C throughout; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Moroccan Chicken with Olives and Lemon
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs slow cooked with olives, lemon zest, turmeric and ginger, served over couscous.
steps: Place the onion, garlic, spices, lemon, olives and stock in the slow cooker and nestle in the chicken.
Cook on low for 6 hours until the chicken falls from the bone and reaches 75°C.
Prepare the couscous with boiling water until the grains are tender, and serve with the chicken, juices and coriander.
notes: Contains gluten (couscous).
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Beef Rib Ragu with Soft Polenta
recipes.summary: Beef short ribs cooked until tender in a rich tomato sauce and served on creamy polenta.
steps: Brown the ribs in a hot pan for 8 minutes and add to the slow cooker with the onion, carrot, garlic, paste, tomatoes, stock and thyme.
Cook on low for 9 hours until the meat falls off the bone; remove the bones and shred the meat.
Cook the polenta in 4 cups of water until thick, stir through the parmesan and serve under the ragu.
notes: Contains dairy.
Food safety: cook beef until tender and at least 75°C throughout; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Pressure-Cooker Chicken Congee with Ginger and Spring Onion
recipes.summary: A silky rice porridge with chicken, ginger and spring onion, ready in about 40 minutes.
steps: Add the rice, chicken, stock and ginger to the pressure cooker, seal and cook at high pressure for 20 minutes, then release naturally.
Lift out the chicken, check it reaches 75°C, shred, then stir the congee until creamy.
Serve topped with the chicken, spring onion, soy and sesame oil.
notes: Contains soy, gluten and sesame.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Pressure-Cooker Pea and Ham Hock Stew
recipes.summary: A thick stew of split peas, carrot and smoked ham hock, cooked in about an hour.
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil on the sauté setting for 5 minutes.
Add the peas, hock, water and bay leaves, seal and cook at high pressure for 40 minutes, then release naturally.
Shred the meat from the hock, return it to the pot and stir until the stew is thick.
notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: pork must reach 70°C or more with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Miso-Glazed Salmon with Sweet Potato and Bok Choy
recipes.summary: Salmon glazed with miso and honey, roasted with sweet potato and bok choy on one tray.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Roast the sweet potato with the oil for 15 minutes.
Mix the miso, honey and vinegar, brush onto the salmon, add the fish and bok choy to the tray and roast for 12 minutes until the salmon flakes.
Rest for 2 minutes, then serve the salmon and vegetables over the rice with the tray juices.
notes: Contains soy, gluten and fish. Dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: One-Pot Beef and Vegetable Pasta
recipes.summary: Beef mince, tomato and short pasta cooked together in one pot with grated vegetables.
steps: Brown the mince, onion and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes until no pink remains.
Add the carrot, zucchini, tomatoes, stock, oregano and pasta, cover and simmer for 18 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the parmesan and serve.
notes: Contains gluten and dairy.
Food safety: mince must reach 75°C throughout with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: One-Pot Coconut Prawn and Rice with Lime
recipes.summary: Prawns steamed on top of coconut rice with ginger and lime, all in one pot.
steps: Bring the rice, coconut milk, water and ginger to a simmer, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Scatter the prawns and peas over the rice, cover and cook for 6 minutes until the rice is tender and the prawns are pink.
Stir in the lime, coriander and chilli and serve.
notes: Gluten free and dairy free. Contains crustacean shellfish.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: One-Pot Chickpea, Spinach and Feta Orzo
recipes.summary: Orzo cooked in tomato stock with chickpeas and spinach, finished with feta and lemon.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the orzo, chickpeas, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 12 minutes, stirring, until the orzo is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the lemon, and crumble over the feta.
notes: Contains gluten and dairy. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Iftar Chicken Biryani with Cucumber Raita
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken layered with fragrant basmati rice and finished with a cooling raita.
steps: Brown the onions in the oil for 12 minutes until golden, then add the chicken, garlic, ginger, spices and half the yoghurt and cook for 15 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Boil the rice in salted water for 6 minutes until just tender and drain. Layer over the chicken with the mint, cover tightly and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Mix the cucumber into the remaining yoghurt for the raita and serve alongside.
notes: Contains dairy. Gluten free.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Suhoor Savoury Oats with Egg and Spinach
recipes.summary: Slow-release oats cooked with stock, topped with a soft egg, spinach and cheese for a filling pre-dawn meal.
steps: Simmer the oats in the stock for 6 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy; stir in the spinach until wilted.
Fry the eggs in the oil for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Spoon the oats into bowls and top with the egg and cheese.
notes: Contains egg, dairy and gluten.
Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Eid Slow-Roasted Lamb Shoulder with Spiced Rice and Almonds
recipes.summary: Lamb shoulder roasted slowly with cumin and garlic, served on fragrant rice with toasted almonds.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C. Stud the lamb with the garlic, rub with the spices, oil and salt, add the stock to the tray, cover tightly with foil and roast for 4 hours until the meat is tender and falls apart.
Cook the rice until tender. Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden.
Shred the lamb, serve over the rice with the almonds and parsley.
notes: Contains nuts. Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: cook lamb until tender and at least 75°C throughout; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Passover Braised Beef Brisket with Carrots and Potatoes
recipes.summary: Brisket braised slowly with onions, carrots and potatoes in its own juices for the holiday table.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C. Rub the brisket with paprika and salt and sear in the oil for 8 minutes.
Place the brisket on the onion, garlic, paste, stock, carrot and potatoes in a deep tray, cover tightly and braise for 3 hours until fork-tender.
Rest for 15 minutes, slice across the grain and spoon over the juices.
notes: Gluten free and dairy free. Check labels for Passover certification if observing.
Food safety: cook beef until tender and at least 75°C throughout; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Lunar New Year Longevity Noodles with Chicken and Mushrooms
recipes.summary: Long wheat noodles stir-fried with chicken, mushrooms and greens, left uncut for good fortune.
steps: Cook the noodles until tender, drain and toss with the sesame oil.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes until cooked through at 75°C, add the mushrooms, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the bok choy, soy and noodles and toss for 3 minutes until hot and the greens are tender.
notes: Contains egg, gluten, soy and sesame.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Lunar New Year Steamed Chicken with Ginger and Shiitake
recipes.summary: Chicken pieces steamed over rice with ginger and shiitake mushrooms in a light soy sauce.
steps: Toss the chicken with the soy, vinegar, ginger and mushrooms in a heatproof dish.
Steam for 25 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Drizzle with sesame oil, scatter with spring onion and serve with the rice.
notes: Contains soy, gluten and sesame. Dairy free.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Lemon and Thyme Beef Burgers with Beetroot and Caramelised Onion
recipes.summary: Beef burgers with lemon zest and thyme, beetroot and caramelised onion in a bun.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil with the sugar on low for 15 minutes until soft and golden.
Mix the mince with the lemon zest, thyme and salt, shape into 4 patties and pan-fry for 5 minutes each side until no pink remains and they reach 75°C.
Top with the cheese until melted and build in the buns with the beetroot, onion and rocket.
notes: Contains dairy, gluten and soy.
Food safety: mince must reach 75°C throughout with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Barbecue Whole Snapper with Chilli, Lime and Herb Salad
recipes.summary: A whole snapper grilled over medium heat and finished with a chilli lime dressing and herbs.

items: 1 whole snapper, about 1.2kg, scaled and gutted

steps: Slash the fish, oil it and grill over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes each side until the flesh flakes at the thickest part.
Whisk the lime, chilli, fish sauce and the remaining oil.
Toss the herbs and cucumber and serve with the fish and dressing.
notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
